primary_inference.resampling: Null-model residuals divided rowwise by sqrt(1-h_ii), with one shared Rademacher sign per country-locality cluster
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across mtDNA and Y

exploratory_within_locality_test.subset: localities represented in more than one period

haplogroup_harmonization.mtDNA_HV: retained as HV, separate from H
haplogroup_harmonization.basal_Y_compounds: Basal/unresolved, including CF, CT, F and IJK
haplogroup_harmonization.rare_pooling: fewer than five primary calls pooled as Other
haplogroup_harmonization.Y_resolution_sensitivity: AADR ISOGG call prefix: first letter + first integer + immediately following branch letter; nomenclature sensitivity only, not a phylogenetic re-call

rng_streams: Stable SHA-256-named NumPy SeedSequence streams; each procedure is independent of unrelated random calls

site_cluster_bootstrap.draw: one multinomial multiplicity per cluster, shared across all periods and, in the paired analysis, both markers

paired_y_resolution_diagnostics.warning: Resolution comparison is an encoding sensitivity, not a demographic or phylogenetic test

recomputed_from.reason: Corrected observed/bootstrap reporting, added sparse-table Monte Carlo diagnostics, and relabeled date assignment as scenario sensitivity; upstream catalogue unchanged

public_coordinate_policy.rationale: reduce archaeological site-location precision; coordinates are not used in statistical models

date_assignment_scenario_sensitivity.direct_dates: Normal in BP using catalogue mean and SD
date_assignment_scenario_sensitivity.indirect_dates: Uniform in BP over mean +/- sqrt(3) times catalogue SD
date_assignment_scenario_sensitivity.interpretation: Assumption-based chronological-bin boundary sensitivity; not calibrated radiocarbon posterior uncertainty
